# Core Rule 6 - In-game administration rulings are final
Admin actions are final. If you have any issues with said actions please report it in the discord server.
If you cannot get into the discord, feel free to DM Armok.
Making a new account to dodge a ban will result in being banned forever.
## Examples
### [bold] Permitted [/bold]
- Reporting suspected admin abuse in the discord or to Armok.
### [bold] Not Permitted [/bold]
- Making a big fuss in the ahelp menu over an admin ruling. - Evading a game ban with new accounts. - Evading a job ban via in game promotion.
